description: Implementation of QuicSendControlStream class handling HTTP/3 control stream operations in QUIC protocol, including sending settings, priority updates, and go-away frames.

classes.name: QuicSendControlStream
classes.description: Handles sending control frames over a QUIC HTTP/3 control stream, including settings, priority updates, and go-away frames.

methods.name: QuicSendControlStream
methods.description: Constructor initializing the control stream with session and settings.

methods.name: OnStreamReset
methods.description: Handles stream reset events, logs bug if called.

methods.name: OnStopSending
methods.description: Handles stop sending signals, reports error.

methods.name: MaybeSendSettingsFrame
methods.description: Sends the settings frame if not already sent, including greasing frames.

methods.name: WritePriorityUpdate
methods.description: Sends a priority update frame for a specific stream.

methods.name: SendGoAway
methods.description: Sends a GOAWAY frame indicating stream termination.
